debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-l-a-b-e-l-e-d the i-m-p-o-r-t-e-d m-e-d-i-c-i-n-e and left f-a-l-s-e b-a-r-c-o-d-e l-a-b-e-l-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
2) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-p-l-e-t-e-d the s-e-r-i-a-l-i-z-a-t-i-o-n f-i-e-l-d-s and left i-n-v-a-l-i-d t-r-a-c-e a-b-i-l-i-t-y r-e-c-o-r-d-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-y-s-t-e-m a-u-d-i-t l-o-g r-e-v-i-e-w
3) the a-c-t-o-r o-v-e-r-r-o-d-e the c-o-l-d-c-h-a-i-n t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e log and left d-i-s-t-o-r-t-e-d s-t-o-r-a-g-e d-a-t-a while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-a-l-i-b-r-a-t-e-d s-e-n-s-o-r c-h-e-c-k
4) the a-c-t-o-r r-o-u-t-e-d the p-r-o-d-u-c-t to p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n and left i-n-c-o-m-p-l-e-t-e i-n-v-o-i-c-e r-e-c-o-r-d-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-i-c-e-n-s-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
5) the a-c-t-o-r i-g-n-o-r-e-d the r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y r-e-p-o-r-t i-n-g o-b-l-i-g-a-t-i-o-n and left u-n-f-i-l-e-d a-d-v-e-r-s-e e-v-e-n-t r-e-c-o-r-d-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e f-i-l-i-n-g
